name: maverick-mcp-revision-aware-price-basis-89b2
instr:
Maverick cannot identify raw, split-adjusted, and total-return histories across persistence and derived analytics. Add immutable, comparable revision identities while preserving existing behavior when price-basis arguments are omitted.

Apply ordered splits and dividends to a copy of raw history with deterministic price and volume semantics. Equivalent normalized actions must yield equal revisions for the same ticker, interval, range, basis, and actions. Reject invalid, contradictory, overlapping, or out-of-range actions atomically with `PriceBasisConflictError`, including ticker, session, `expected_revision`, and `actual_revision`.

Preserve frames, indexes, dtypes, actions, basis, revision, and remaining lifetime through storage, every cache tier, and SQLite backfill. Isolate bases and superseded revisions so corrected values cannot be replaced by stale memory values.

Keep each technical analysis, screen, feature matrix, snapshot, and backtest on one revision. Reject mismatches before snapshots change or trades execute, accept the signal identity through the `signal_revision` keyword argument, and report the accepted identity. Keep EMA and ratio features index-aligned with established finite fallbacks. Feature extraction must return the established seventy-five columns, their ordering and fill behavior, basis, and revision.
